evaluation.interpretation: Accuracy and candidate precision/recall use available classifications only. Unavailable results and timings are reported separately. Classification is not an instruction to act.

calibration.interpretation: Zero observed false positives on a small calibration set does not establish production safety or calibrated probabilities. Holdout outcomes are not used to select this threshold.

thresholdEvaluation.interpretation: The calibration threshold is applied unchanged to every evaluated group. Unavailable classifications are excluded from precision/recall and counted separately. This measures label/probability filtering, not the full observer disposition or authorization to act.

limitations: Authored fictional fixtures; related scenario templates cross splits.
